#### Project general facts

Majestique Residence 1 is a visionary development where world-class design meets exceptional build quality, setting a new standard for modern living. Crafted by visionary developers, this completed residence redefines spacious apartments and creates a benchmark of luxury for the area. Offering studios and one and two-bedroom apartments with multi-level designs ensuring impressive views, each residence is designed to perfection with meticulous attention to detail.

The development boasts an array of lifestyle amenities that cater to every facet of life, from work and play to fitness and education, all conveniently located within walking distance. Residents can enjoy a fulfilling lifestyle where every need is catered to without venturing far from home. The thoughtful integration of amenities ensures a seamless blend of comfort, convenience, and community living.

Each residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens, creating living spaces that exude contemporary elegance and functionality. The apartments are fully furnished, offering residents immediate comfort and style without the hassle of furnishing. Every detail has been carefully considered to provide a sophisticated and comfortable home environment that residents will love.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Dubai South, a visionary urban development at the heart of Dubai that embodies the emirate's forward-looking spirit and aims to redefine modern integrated community living. The expansive master-planned city is strategically positioned to play a pivotal role in Dubai's growth and global connectivity. Dubai South is structured around key pillars such as innovation, connectivity, and accessibility, creating a thriving and sustainable ecosystem.

The area is home to Al Maktoum International Airport, poised to become the world's largest and most advanced aviation hub, connecting people and businesses across the globe. The development's strategic location near key transportation networks ensures excellent connectivity for residents and businesses alike. The community's emphasis on creating a self-sustaining environment ensures that residents have access to essential services without venturing far from home.

The city integrates commercial districts, logistics centers, entertainment hubs, and educational institutions, creating a truly integrated urban experience. Dubai South encapsulates the city's dedication to shaping the future as a hub for urban living, business opportunities, and international connectivity. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of strategic positioning, sustainable living, and urban convenience, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most ambitious and visionary communities.
